1_1_7_2.name: The Upper Prison

notes: Log out after you kill Brutus then Waypoint to Prisoner's Gate

facts: Leads to: Prisoner's Gate, The Ship Graveyard Cave, The Cavern of Wrath
notes: Otherwise continue directly to Cavern of Wrath Waypoint

1_1_town.name: Lioneye's Watch
facts: Leads to: The Twilight Strand, The Coast

1_2_1.name: The Southern Forest
facts: Leads to: The Cavern of Anger

notes: Kill Weaver for the reward and logout, then claim The Way Forward skillpoint back in Act 1

1_3_15.hint: Follow the road until the end

notes: TP back to the The Library with currency in your inventory

2_8_4.hint: Follow path to the end to kill Yugul

2_8_5.name: The Bath House
2_8_5.hint: The exit (1) is always on the right side. Save Yugul (2) for later
facts: Leads to: The Grand Promenade, The Lunaris Concourse, The High Gardens, The Hidden Underbelly

2_8_6.name: The Lunaris Concourse
2_8_6.hint: Go up and right for Waypoint then up and left for entrance to Lunaris Temple first
facts: Leads to: The Bath House, The Lunaris Temple Level 1, The Harbour Bridge
notes: Go down and right to the Harbour Bridge after beating both temples

2_8_7_1_.name: The Lunaris Temple Level 1
2_8_7_1_.hint: Follow the carpets until end activate the Waypoint
facts: Leads to: The Lunaris Concourse, The Lunaris Temple Level 2

2_8_7_2.name: The Lunaris Temple Level 2
2_8_7_2.hint: Look for staircases and go up these, when you reach the larger area, look for vases on the opposite wall and pick the side where there is only one
facts: Leads to: The Lunaris Temple Level 1
notes: Log out after Boss and Waypoint to Doedre's Cesspool

2_8_8.name: The Quay
2_8_8.hint: Pick up the quest item at (1) to use in the arena (2) then leave the arena and find the exit at (3)
facts: Leads to: Doedre's Cesspool, The Grain Gate
notes: Stick to the bottom edge of the map and you should find everything

2_8_9.name: The Grain Gate
2_8_9.hint: This zone has many buildings, only enter and leave buildings through openings that have a guard's corpse next to it; they lead the way
facts: Leads to: The Quay, The Imperial Fields, The Hidden Underbelly

2_8_town.name: The Sarn Encampment
facts: Leads to: The Sarn Ramparts, The Toxic Conduits, Aspirants' Plaza, Sarn Arena

2_9_1.name: The Blood Aqueduct
2_9_1.hint: Go to the top left, cross the bridges on dead ends
notes: Farm Humility cards for Tabula for league starter
This zone is great for EXP

2_9_10_1.name: The Belly of the Beast
2_9_10_1.hint: Head top left in this zone and the next
facts: Leads to: The Quarry, The Rotting Core

2_9_10_2.name: The Rotting Core
2_9_10_2.hint: Kill Doedre, Maligaro, and Shavronne again. Then enter the Black Heart and kill the Depraved Trinity
facts: Leads to: The Belly of the Beast
notes: RECOMMEND 3,200+ EHP, physical mitigations, lightning resist, fast movement skill

2_9_2.name: The Descent
2_9_2.hint: Go up right to the supply hoist, then down left to another hoist then up right to The Vastiri Desert

2_9_3.name: The Vastiri Desert
2_9_3.hint: Go right to the Waypoint, then top left (1) for the Foothills.
facts: Crafting recipe: Attack and Cast Speed - Rank 2
Leads to: The Descent, The Oasis, The Foothills
notes: If you want to kill Shakari, go right to (2) for the Oasis, then get the quest item in town and enter the zone

2_9_4.name: The Oasis
2_9_4.hint: Left or right wall follow, based on bottom or top being the dead end at the entrance

2_9_5.name: The Foothills
2_9_5.hint: Then go right to (1) to get the quest item in The Boiling Lake, then up to (2) for The Tunnel to continue the story
facts: Leads to: The Vastiri Desert, The Boiling Lake, The Tunnel
notes: Don't forget to touch the Waypoint

2_9_6.name: The Boiling Lake
2_9_6.hint: Go to the top right of zone, If you spot petrified men you are close
notes: After killing the Basilisk, log out and teleport to the Waypoint in The Foothills and go to the top left corner of the zone

2_9_7.name: The Tunnel
2_9_7.hint: Go up left, the right path leads past the Waypoint
facts: Leads to: The Foothills, The Quarry

2_9_8.name: The Quarry
2_9_8.hint: Activate Waypoint at center, do Shrine of the Winds (2), then The Refinery (1)
facts: Leads to: The Tunnel, The Refinery, The Belly of the Beast

2_9_9.name: The Refinery
2_9_9.hint: Follow the cart tracks to the building top left for Boss.
facts: Crafting recipe: Trigger a Socketed Spell when you Use a Skill or Focus
notes: Log out to town and use Waypoint to The Quarry

2_9_town.name: Highgate
facts: Leads to: The Blood Aqueduct, The Descent
